The Story

Why does Nordic football
make you better?

Scandinavian football is built on structure, physicality, and tactical discipline. It demands things of players that comfort zones never will — faster decisions, cleaner mechanics, sharper reading of the game.

The Nordic Pro Experience puts you inside that environment. Not as a tourist. As a player with a plan, a coach watching every rep, and data tracking every movement.

This is for the player who wants a European benchmark — honest, measurable, and earned.

What is the Program

A European
benchmark
for serious
players.

An intensive immersion designed for elite, ambitious players from the US and beyond. Train twice daily in small groups, play competitive weekend matches, and receive individual evaluation through Futeval+ and Kinematics Analysis.

Training 2× daily, 5 days/week + weekend matches
Max 5 players per coach — high touch, high feedback
Futeval+ written assessments + Kinematics baseline
Lodging, 3 meals/day, laundry + airport transfers
Arranged trials with pro & semi-pro clubs (Sweden/Finland)
Goalkeepers & female players welcome

Why Nordic Pro

What makes
this different.

Nordic football is organized, physical, and tactical. An honest benchmark for players who want evidence — not just a trip.

A Clean Benchmark

Train inside a demanding, unfamiliar environment. Nordic standards expose exactly what you need to fix — with objective data from day one, not assumptions.

Individual Focus

Daily coaching ratios, written assessments, video review, Kinematics Analysis. You don't train in the average. Everything adapts to your profile and position.

A Pathway, Not a Promise

We don't sell contracts. We build readiness, showcase you in matches, and arrange trials where realistic — with clear, honest feedback at every stage.

"You leave with evidence, not guesses. A documented player profile, objective movement metrics, and an individualized improvement plan."

Where You'll Train

Campus Vaxholm.
Stockholm Archipelago.

Sweden's Stockholm Archipelago is one of the most demanding training environments in the world. Campus Vaxholm is a professional facility used by Swedish football clubs, set on the water 40 minutes from central Stockholm.

You won't be training in a tourist-friendly bubble. You'll be inside a real Swedish football environment — structured, professional, and built around performance.

Professional facility used by Swedish clubs

Natural grass + turf pitches on the archipelago

On-site lodging, dining, and recovery facilities

40-min transfer from Stockholm Arlanda (ARN)

After the Program

Where does
this lead?

The Nordic Pro Experience doesn't end when your program does. Players leave with documented profiles, arranged trial contacts, and honest pathways — not vague promises.

Trial
Arrangements

We facilitate introductions and arrange trials with Swedish and Finnish clubs where the fit is realistic. You play — we watch, report, and follow up.

Shoza VIK
Pathway

The strongest 90-day performers are considered for a pathway with Shoza VIK — one of our partner clubs in the Swedish league structure.

Player
Profile Export

Every player leaves with a shareable digital profile — Futeval+ report, kinematics data, video library — useful for clubs, agents, and college programs anywhere.
